dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived flood evolution assessment - 16 September 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20220808PAK, GDACS Id: 1101522** Status: Overall decreasing flood waters observed Further action(s): continue monitoring Evolution of Cumulative Flood Impact Assessment (01 - 07 September Vs 08-14 September 2022): From 08 to 14 September 2022 approximately 19 million people remain potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas; Based on satellite observations from 01-07 September 2022 and 08-14 September 2022, the overall flood situation appears to be decreasing  with approximately 1,700 km² in Balochistan, ~Punjab 3,900 km²  and  ~850 km² in Sindh. The dotted line represents approximately the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir agreed upon by India and Pakistan. The final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not been agreed upon by the parties. The boundary and names shown on this map do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the United Nations.
